name: siegler-plugins
description: Bill Siegler's Claude Code plugins: delegation tiering enforcement, steering-mechanism guidance, the instrument that tests whether steering text earns its place, and their freshness pipeline.

plugins.name: delegation-tiering
plugins.description: Model/effort tiering for every delegated agent: tier-ladder skill, deterministic PreToolUse gate, per-delegation ledger, live canary.

plugins.name: steering-claude-code
plugins.description: A single skill: the decision guide for where a Claude Code behavior should live, with enforcement mechanics per option.

plugins.name: ablation
plugins.description: A single skill: tests whether a piece of instruction text still earns its place, by running matched tasks with and without it under blind judging — and reports the smallest difference the design could have detected.
